title: Why You Instantly Know Where Sounds Come From
hook: Your brain uses a clever trick to pinpoint sound direction.

narration.text: Your brain uses a clever trick to pinpoint sound direction.
Close your eyes and have a friend make a sound from different spots.
Notice how easily you can tell where it is coming from.
This happens because your ears are spaced apart.
Sound reaches one ear milliseconds before the other.
Your brain analyses this tiny time difference.
This allows you to accurately locate the source.
Try it right now, then tell us if it worked for you in the comments.

description: Ever wondered why you instantly know where a sound is coming from? It's all thanks to a fascinating trick your brain uses with the tiny time difference in sound reaching each ear. Learn how this natural ability helps you navigate your world.
topic: Why your brain can instantly tell the direction a sound is coming from. Close your eyes and have a friend make a sound from different places.
